name: naukri-scraper
description: Local-only Naukri job scraper. Naukri's search API 406s on unauthenticated requests, and headless Chrome gets an outright Akamai Access Denied — only a real, visible browser on a real desktop session gets through. Must run on a machine with an actual display (e.g. via Windows Task Scheduler set to "Run only when user is logged on"), never headless, never on a headless server.
